single_source_caveat: Real CIC IoMT 2024 provides one capture-pipeline source, not five. CorrelationAwareWeighting and the multi-dimension vector particle state were not exercised meaningfully on this data -- see real_source_fusion.py docstring.

local_windows_replication.note: Local Windows replication (Python 3.11.9, F: drive). Platform differences explain minor deviation from canonical sandbox results.
